name: Electronic Techniques for Signal Conditioning and Interfacing
description: Fundamental of designing electronic conditioning modules for various transducers/sensors. Selection of active electronic components for signal conditioning circuits; effect of component non-idealities on sensor performance. Precision electronic conditioning and interfacing requirements in terms of single ended, differential, and input/output impedances. Signal conditioning circuits for resistive sensors: wheatstone bridge, current excitation based half bridge, lead resistance compensation methods. Signal conditioning circuits for capacitive sensors, phase-sensitive-detection, lock-in amplifier, chopping, and auto-nulling techniques for precision measurement. Signal conditioning and interfacing circuits for optical sensors, thermocouples, strain-gauge circuit, LVDT and bio-potential sensors. Microcontroller applications in smart sensing and instrumentation, dataloggers. Interfacing sensors with microcontroller.
